AboutPageSettings.LeadText: Locally owned and operated by Scotty Barrera, Southern Shield Waterproofing delivers specialized foundation protection, exterior drainage, and moisture control solutions tailored for Tennessee terrain and weather.
WhoIAmBullets: Experienced waterproofing specialists dedicated to keeping basements, crawl spaces, and foundations bone-dry.
Committed to punctuality, upfront communication, and rigorous installation standards on every job site.
Locally operated in Southeast Tennessee with deep knowledge of regional soil types, heavy rains, and water runoff dynamics.
WhyStartedParagraphs: We founded Southern Shield Waterproofing to offer homeowners and builders a dependable contractor focused exclusively on moisture barrier protection and foundation water management.

By combining modern commercial-grade waterproofing membranes with proper footing drainage and rock protection, we solve moisture issues right at the source before they can compromise your home's structural health.
AboutPageSettings.ClosingQuote: Your foundation is the bedrock of your home—we make sure it stays shielded.
AboutPageSettings.ClosingText: Whether you are breaking ground on new construction or remedying persistent water seepage around your foundation, we are ready to assist.

ServicesPageSettings.Heading: Our Waterproofing Services
ServicesPageSettings.LeadText: Explore our comprehensive suite of foundation and site drainage services designed to shield your home from water damage.

Services.Title: Foundation Footing Treatment
Services.Description: Precision preparation, sealing, and waterproof coating of foundation footings to eliminate capillary water absorption and wicking at the base of your structure.

Services.Title: Waterproofing Wall Membrane
Services.Description: Application of high-performance elastomeric and sheet membranes on foundation walls to create an impenetrable barrier against soil moisture and hydrostatic pressure.

Services.Title: Drainage Systems (French Drains)
Services.Description: Custom-engineered perforated pipe and aggregate French drain installations that capture groundwater at the footing level and direct it safely away.

Services.Title: Backfill Protection
Services.Description: Installation of dimpled drainage boards and protective layers that safeguard freshly applied waterproof membranes from damage during soil backfilling and compaction.

ServicesPageSettings.SpotlightText: Water intrusion can cause mold, wood rot, foundation shifting, and thousands of dollars in structural damage. A properly installed waterproofing system pays for itself in peace of mind.
ServicesPageSettings.HiringText: We are always looking for dependable, hard-working professionals to join our waterproofing crew.
